verdict.rationale: No evidence in the pack addresses AI training data usage or opt-out controls for Rollbar's data; the docs cover error monitoring, integrations, and data retention but never mention AI/ML model training policies. This axis is applicable to any modern SaaS product with AI features (Rollbar has an AI agent 'Resolve' and MCP server), but no documentation or community evidence confirms a way to prevent data from being used to train AI models.
